name: Embedded LLM - High throughput LLM inference with vLLM and AMD (MI210 vs A100 vs L40)
notes: Oct 27 2023. vLLM v0.1.4 (EmbeddedLLM ROCm port) on MI210 64GB HBM2e; vLLM v0.1.4 on A100-80GB-SXM and L40. Offline throughput of 1000 questions, LLaMA2-7B (1 GPU), 13B (2 GPU TP), 70B (4 GPU TP). Tables 3+4: tok/s and req/min. Third-party measured.
